people.name: Joseph
people.line: Son of Jacob, ruler in Egypt

translations.web: Joseph hurried, for his heart yearned over his brother; and he sought a place to weep. He entered into his room, and wept there.
translations.bsb: Joseph hurried out because he was moved to tears for his brother, and he went to a private room to weep.
translations.kjv: And Joseph made haste; for his bowels did yearn upon his brother: and he sought where to weep; and he entered into his chamber, and wept
translations.asv: And Joseph made haste; for his heart yearned over his brother: and he sought where to weep; and he entered into his chamber, and wept there.
